note: Resolve relative plugin options (devupFile, distDir, cssDir), the tsconfig and the webpack extraction ids against the bundler's project root (Vite root, webpack context, Rsbuild rootPath, Next's project directory for webpack builds, Bun.build root) instead of process.cwd(), so builds started from a parent directory as turbo or nx do read the project's devup.json and write its df. Builds started from the project root are unchanged. When devupFile is not set and only the working directory holds a devup.json, that file is still read and a one-time warning says to move it next to the project or set devupFile. Class names may change once for webpack and Next webpack builds run from a parent directory, because files are now numbered relative to the project root.
